title: Multi-Index Infinite Hits - Show More/Show Previous on refresh Bug
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

When I have multi index widgets and they have the infiniteHits widget, the bug occurs on those that aren't tied to the searchbox index.

Bug: On the second infiniteHits widget, When 'Show More Results' and 'Show Previous Results' are clickable, I click on 'Show More Results' and the results populate. I then click on 'Show Previous Results' and it'll take multiple clicks for the previous results to show up. the click count begins to increment where it starts playing catch up for each "Show Previous/Show More" button.
 


### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

To recreate: on the second infiniteHits widget, 

Click show more results > 
refresh the preview > 
click show more results again > 
click show previous results,  you have to click twice here >
click show more results, it will take 3 clicks here. The click count will keep going up for each button when following this pattern.

### Live reproduction

https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/prod-meadow-dtnhyf?file=%2Fsrc%2Fapp.js

### 💭 Expected behavior

Show More Results and Show Previous Results should populate the results without needing multiple clicks. It should work like the first infiniteHits widget.

### Package version

instantsearch.js 4.78.3

### Operating system

Windows 10

### Browser

Chrome
